title: Peru and Lake Titicaca
text:
Peru is a country in South America. The capital is Lima. Peru has mountains, beaches and big rivers.

Lake Titicaca is a big lake. It is high in the mountains. Many boats sail on it.

questions.text: What is the capital of Peru?
Why do people probably use boats on the lake?
options: To travel and move across the water
To build houses in the mountains

questions.text: Why is the lake probably cold?
options: Because it is high in the mountains
Because it is near the sun
Because it is in a desert
Because it is in a hot city

vocabulary.definition: an area of land with its own government and people
the main city where the government of a country is
very high areas of land with steep sides
a large area of water with land all around it

paragraph_translations: Perú es un país de América del Sur. La capital es Lima. Perú tiene montañas, playas y ríos grandes.
El lago Titicaca es un lago grande. Está en lo alto de las montañas. Muchos barcos navegan en él.
